Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
robtreasure wrote:
> Apologies, can't access Google. How does the new NRA stuff interact with
> the explicit text on CoT?

No effect on CoT.

> Current text:
> Change of Target
> Only usable when this action minion is blocked (play before combat if
> any). Untap the acting minion, do not tap the blocking minion, and end
> the current action (it is not successful). **This minion cannot perform
> the same action again this turn**
>
> "Is governed by the "same action" rulings. [RTR 19950509]"
>
> Is this RTR still valid for new multi hunt, rescue etc.
> Thanks

Still valid? Yes.
A hunt is the same action as a hunt (the RTR is still valid).
So if a vampire is blocked while hunting and plays CoT, he cannot hunt again
this turn.

Messages.Body:
In message <3512...@web2news.com>, Kulaid <kulaid.news.invalid@web2new

s.net> writes:
>Ira wrote:
>> If an empty vampire hunts, and then untaps and is still
>> empty, must it hunt again?
>

>The vampire must hunt, but can not...

Only if the untap was from Change of Target or similar. (Per the
subject line, but not expressed in this question.)

If the vampire hunts successfully, untaps (via Freak Drive, say) and
finds himself on zero blood, he can (and must) hunt again, assuming no
other restrictions in force.
